name: Oka Castle
description: Oka Castle, on a 325 m plateau, was the Sengoku stronghold of the Shiga clan and later the Nakagawa domain seat. The massive stone walls and the autumn views of the valley are its draw; the castle ruins are a national historic site.
notes: Free open-air site; admission is free, the climb is steep but short from the parking area.
